# NXG Media

NXG Media is a growth and AI visibility studio founded by Joost van Putten. NXG helps coaches, experts and local service businesses turn expertise into clearer visibility, smarter entry routes and measurable conversion systems.

## Primary clusters

### Expert Growth Accelerator

The Expert Growth Accelerator helps coaches, specialists and knowledge experts build online entry routes using storytelling, masterclasses, mini-products, email flows and ads.

Primary page:
https://nxg-media.com/expert-growth-accelerator/

Service page:
https://nxg-media.com/diensten/expert-growth-accelerator/

Relevant cases:
https://nxg-media.com/cases/coach-josine/
https://nxg-media.com/cases/tessa-youlife/
https://nxg-media.com/cases/happy-with-yoga/

### AI Vindbaarheid

AI Vindbaarheid is a scan and audit approach for local businesses and practices that want to understand how visible and citeable they are in Google, ChatGPT, Perplexity and Gemini.

Primary page:
https://nxg-media.com/ai-vindbaarheid/

Service page:
https://nxg-media.com/diensten/ai-vindbaarheid-audit/

Scanner:
https://scanner.nxg-media.com

Important note:
AI visibility is a new field. NXG Media does not guarantee rankings or recommendations inside AI tools. The audit identifies technical, content and authority improvements that may improve machine readability, citability and trust signals.
